clips.speaker: kopi
clips.text: Welcome to KD Hot Topic! I'm Kopi.

clips.speaker: kenji
clips.text: And I'm Kenji. Today's hottest fight in AI? Models that refuse to talk.

clips.speaker: kopi
clips.text: Wait. A model that doesn't talk? Kenji, that's literally my dream coworker.

clips.speaker: kopi
clips.text: It started on September fifteenth. A startup called TypeSafe launched Jev. You give it a question and a list of options, and it just picks one, with a probability. No essays.

clips.speaker: kenji
clips.text: They call it a system one model: fast, gut-feeling decisions. And it's cheap. About four cents per million tokens in, and the output is free.

clips.speaker: kopi
clips.text: Free output? Okay, now I'm listening.

clips.speaker: kenji
clips.text: So was everyone else. TypeSafe launched with a forty million dollar seed. Nine days later, reports said it was in talks at a ten billion dollar valuation.

clips.speaker: kopi
clips.text: Fifty times in nine days? That's faster than my code reviews.

clips.speaker: kenji
clips.text: And fun fact: Jev is named after Jevons, the economist. Make something cheaper, and people use way more of it.

clips.speaker: kopi
clips.text: Then the big labs showed up. At DevDay, OpenAI previewed its own Decisions API, running on GPT-6 Luna. The demo answered in a fraction of a second.

clips.speaker: kenji
clips.text: Not sped up, apparently. I checked.

clips.speaker: kenji
clips.text: And yesterday, the open-source wave. Amazon's Strands Decider runs on a laptop. Cloudflare's Clef-flash answers in thirty-nine milliseconds. Jev takes about five hundred.

clips.speaker: kopi
clips.text: So, Kenji. Gold rush, or the real deal?

clips.speaker: kenji
clips.text: For builders? Real deal. Let the model judge, and let your code act. Routing, tool picks, safety checks. Fast, cheap, and way easier to test.

clips.speaker: kopi
clips.text: Even TypeSafe's boss says most clones are just people chasing a cool architecture.

clips.speaker: kenji
clips.text: Spicy. And that's the hot topic: decision models.

clips.speaker: kopi
clips.text: Now go build something decisive. See you next time, Kracked Devs!
